reviews.title: Somehow Managed to Get this for $320.
reviews.comment:
As the title suggests, I somehow managed to purchase these for $320, which was an insane steal at the time. As of writing, they are now around the same price as they are on other platforms. The lack of RGB and not great transfer speed are not huge knocks against it, and for use in systems with air coolers, the smaller heat spreader is nice. The grey in person is a lot less noticeable than it is online, so do with that what you will. The timings are fantastic, with pretty low CAS latency. You can definitely feel this during use, as even Windows feels snappier than with slower timing RAM. 

Still, the price is much too high now, so I cannot recommend these in good faith versus RAM that is appropriately priced in the $600 price range.
